```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, cache = TRUE, warning = FALSE)

library(png)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)

PlotLocations <- 'C:/Users/swulfing/Documents/GitHub/UMassD/YT_proj/Manuscripts/Plots'

ModNames_proj <- c("Mod_AR1Ecov", "Mod_HistAvgEcov", "Mod_RecWindEcov", "Mod_RecTrendEcov", "Mod_TermYear", "Mod_NoEcov")
ModNames_bias <-  c("Mod_AR1Ecov", "Mod_LOWEcov", "Mod_MEDLOWEcov", "Mod_MEDEcov", "Mod_HIGHEcov", "Mod_NoEcov")
ModNames_biasOMs <- c("Mod_LOWEcov", "Mod_MEDLOWEcov", "Mod_MEDEcov", "Mod_HIGHEcov")

Proj_ests <- readRDS('C:/Users/swulfing/Documents/MSE_results/Combo/Projections_data.rds')
Bias_ests <- readRDS('C:/Users/swulfing/Documents/MSE_results/Biases/Biases_data.rds')

```

```{r paramEsts}
# MAKE A TABLE OF THE PARAMETER ESTIMATES
#Proj_ests <- as.data.frame(Proj_ests)

# PROJECTIONS
paramEsts_projs <- Proj_ests %>%
  group_by(EM_name) %>%
  summarize(OM_ecov = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_mean_overall), digits = 3),
          mean_ecov = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_mean_assessment), digits = 3),
          sd_ecov = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_sd_assessment), digits = 3),
          rho = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_rho_assessment), digits = 3))

#Ecov_processPars_mean

kable(paramEsts_projs, caption = 'Ecov parameter estimates, sd, and rho for each EM for projections test')


# BIASES
meanTable_bias <- data.frame(EM_name = ModNames_bias)
sdTable_bias <- data.frame(EM_name = ModNames_bias)
rhoTable_bias <- data.frame(EM_name = ModNames_bias)

for(i in 1:4){
  data_use <- Bias_ests[[i]]
  
  #mean
  data_clean <- data_use %>%
  group_by(EM_name) %>%
  summarize(ecov_mean = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_mean_overall), digits = 3))
  
  colnames(data_clean) <- c('EM_name', names(Bias_ests[i]) )
  
  meanTable_bias <- merge(meanTable_bias, data_clean, by = 'EM_name')

  #sd
  data_clean <- data_use %>%
  group_by(EM_name) %>%
  summarize(ecov_mean = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_sd_overall), digits = 3))
  
  colnames(data_clean) <- c('EM_name', names(Bias_ests[i]) )
  
  sdTable_bias <- merge(sdTable_bias, data_clean, by = 'EM_name')
  
  #logit_rho
  data_clean <- data_use %>%
  group_by(EM_name) %>%
  summarize(ecov_mean = round(mean(Ecov_processPars_rho_overall), digits = 3))
  
  colnames(data_clean) <- c('EM_name', names(Bias_ests[i]) )
  
  rhoTable_bias <- merge(rhoTable_bias, data_clean, by = 'EM_name')
}



#Ecov_processPars_mean

#kable(paramEsts_projs, caption = 'Ecov parameter estimates, sd, and logit_rho for each EM for projections test')

kable(meanTable_bias, caption = 'mean ecov parameter estimates, or each EM and OM for bias test')

kable(sdTable_bias, caption = 'mean sd estimates, or each EM and OM for bias test')

kable(rhoTable_bias, caption = 'rho parameter estimates, or each EM and OM for bias test')

```

```{r paramEsts_yearly_proj}
# Write the yearly estimations
paramEsts_yearly <- Proj_ests %>%
  group_by(EM_name,Year) %>%
  summarize(OM_ecov = mean(Ecov_processPars_mean_overall),
          EM_ecov = mean(Ecov_processPars_mean_assessment))

paramEsts_yearly$EM_ecov <- seq(1,nrow(paramEsts_yearly), by = 1)

ggplot(paramEsts_yearly, aes(x = Year, y = EM_ecov, color = EM_name)) +
  geom_line()


print(YearlyParams_proj)
ggsave(paste0(PlotLocations,'/YearlyParams_proj.png'), plot = YearlyParams_proj)

```

```{r paramEsts_yearly_bias}
# Write the yearly estimations

for(i in 1:4){

  group_by(EM_name,Year) %>%

          EM_ecov = mean(Ecov_processPars_mean_assessment))
```

```{r catchAdvice_proj, fig.cap = 'mean catch advice for each EM in projections test'}

# resulting catch advice

catchAdvice_projs <- Proj_ests %>%
  filter(Year >= 2024) %>%
  group_by(EM_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(mean_catchAdvice = mean(Catch_advice),
          sd_catchAdvice = sd(Catch_advice))

ggplot(data = catchAdvice_projs, aes(x = Year, y = mean_catchAdvice, group = EM_name, color = EM_name)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_catchAdvice - sd_catchAdvice, ymax = mean_catchAdvice + sd_catchAdvice, fill = EM_name), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r catchAdvicd_bias, fig.cap = 'mean catch advice for each EM in projections test'}

# Biases
catchAdvice_plots <- list()
for(i in 1:4){
  data_use <- Bias_ests[[i]]
  
  data_clean <- data_use %>%
  filter(Year >= 2024) %>%
  group_by(EM_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(mean_catchAdvice = mean(Catch_advice),
          sd_catchAdvice = sd(Catch_advice))
  
  catchAdvice_plots[[i]] <- 
    ggplot(data = data_clean, aes(x = Year, y = mean_catchAdvice, group = EM_name, color = EM_name)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_catchAdvice - sd_catchAdvice, ymax = mean_catchAdvice + sd_catchAdvice, fill = EM_name), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle(names(Bias_ests[i])) +
  ylab ("Catch Advice") +
  theme(legend.position  = 'none')
  
}

ggarrange(catchAdvice_plots[[1]], catchAdvice_plots[[2]], catchAdvice_plots[[3]], catchAdvice_plots[[4]], ncol = 2, nrow = 2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = 'right')

```
